artworks.title: Foot Combat with War Hammers and Tartsche Shields
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in combat. They are clad in elaborate armor and wielding swords. The figures are depicted in medieval style armor, each taking a stance in combat with one another. The figure on the left appears to be striking out with a sword, while the one on the right is positioned to either parry or counter, holding a shield in front. The armor includes detailed features such as plumes and intricate designs reminiscent of historical armor from jousting or tournaments. Their poses suggest movement and engagement in a mock battle or ceremonial duel. The background is left plain, emphasizing the focus on the armored figures.

artworks.title: Foot Combat with Flails
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor and corrected with white gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures engaging in combat with polearms. The figures, clad in medieval-style armor, are depicted in an action pose as they skirmish with long staffs or polearms. The figure on the left is poised with one foot forward and holds the weapon across the body while the figure on the right appears to thrust their weapon toward the opponent. Both figures are dressed in period attire with helmets, ornate midsection armor, and skirts that resemble those worn by gladiators. The background is plain, and the scene is framed by a simple line, focusing the attention solely on the dynamic interaction between the two figures.
